game_concept: A action defense set in Mt. Pyre – Ember Fields, fields of drifting embers: the ember mage must handle molten golems while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Compound Combo: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ember Fields: fields of drifting embers
core_gameplay_loop: In Ember Fields, repeat each round: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly. Each round, molten golems strike the lava bridge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the energy value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the lava bridge from molten golems in Ember Fields: keep the energy meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 31-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: energy drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 31-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 4 (applied tier): Compound Combo
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how energy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against molten golems in Ember Fields.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 31 seconds while energy > 0.
